items.html: Afterward, it elicited the external phases to clothe it. First, it elicited lights from the general, inner AB, which is the Se’arot [hair] of the Keter, surrounding its Rosh from the outside up to the Metzach and up to the Oznayim. Afterward, it elicited the Se’arot of the Zakan [beard] that are extended from the general SAG called Nekudim, from which the general three Mochin in it were made.
